chunks: It is your Lord who drives your ships across the seas that you may seek of His bounty. He is verily kind to you.
ai.seo_question: How does Allah demonstrate His mercy through the sea?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Isra, this verse underscores Allah’s provision of maritime technology as a tangible sign of His mercy, inviting believers to reflect on the ease of livelihood granted to humanity. Shia exegetes often highlight the dual nature of this bounty, noting that while it facilitates trade and exploration, it also serves as a test of gratitude and recognition of the Creator’s benevolence.
